---
title: "Lesson Plan"
---

```{r}
#| label: lesson-plan-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(knitr)
# Only the general workbook helper is used for cf_sheet(), cf_range(),
# and read_workbook_sheet(). No _data_helpers_course_tables dependency.
source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "_data_helpers.R"))

# Excel columns A:I; select B, C, D, E, G, H.
lesson_raw <- read_workbook_sheet(
  cf_sheet("lesson_plan"),
  range = cf_range("lesson_plan"),
  col_names = FALSE
)

if (is.null(lesson_raw)) {
  notify_workbook_missing()
} else {
  if (ncol(lesson_raw) < 8L) stop("Lesson Plan range must contain at least eight columns (A:H)")
  lesson_df <- as.data.frame(lesson_raw[, c(2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8), drop = FALSE])
  names(lesson_df) <- c("Lec. No.", "CO", "Points to be Covered",
                        "Teaching Pedagogy", "Planned Date", "Actual Delivery")
  valid <- !is.na(lesson_df[["Lec. No."]]) &
    nzchar(trimws(as.character(lesson_df[["Lec. No."]])))
  lesson_df <- lesson_df[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(lesson_df) <- NULL

  format_date <- function(x) {
    if (inherits(x, "Date") || inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
      y <- format(x, "%d-%m-%Y")
    } else {
      y <- as.character(x)
    }
    y[is.na(y)] <- ""
    y
  }
  lesson_df[["Planned Date"]] <- format_date(lesson_df[["Planned Date"]])
  lesson_df[["Actual Delivery"]] <- format_date(lesson_df[["Actual Delivery"]])
  lesson_df[] <- lapply(lesson_df, function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    x
  })

  # Consistent alternating light-grey rows across DOCX, PDF, and HTML.
  stripe_hex <- "#E0E0E0"

  if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {
    ft <- flextable::flextable(lesson_df) |>
      flextable::theme_booktabs() |>
      flextable::bg(i = seq(2L, nrow(lesson_df), by = 2L),
                    bg = stripe_hex, part = "body") |>
      flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
      flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
      flextable::padding(padding = 3, part = "all") |>
      flextable::valign(valign = "center", part = "all") |>
      flextable::align(j = c(1, 2, 5, 6), align = "center", part = "all") |>
      flextable::align(j = c(3, 4), align = "left", part = "all") |>
      flextable::width(j = 1, width = 0.45) |>
      flextable::width(j = 2, width = 0.45) |>
      flextable::width(j = 3, width = 2.45) |>
      flextable::width(j = 4, width = 1.25) |>
      flextable::width(j = 5, width = 0.75) |>
      flextable::width(j = 6, width = 0.75) |>
      flextable::set_table_properties(
        layout = "fixed",
        opts_word = list(repeat_headers = TRUE, split = FALSE)
      )
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd(ft)

  } else if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

  # Longtable with horizontally and vertically centered cells
  tbl <- kableExtra::kbl(
    lesson_df,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    align = rep("c", 6)
  ) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("repeat_header", "striped"),
      stripe_color = "gray!12",
      font_size = 9,
      full_width = FALSE
    ) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
  1, width = "0.45in",
  latex_column_spec = "C{0.45in}"
) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      2, width = "0.45in",
      latex_column_spec = "C{0.45in}"
    ) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      3, width = "2.45in",
      latex_column_spec = "L{2.25in}"
    ) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      4, width = "1.25in",
      latex_column_spec = "L{1.45in}"
    ) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      5, width = "0.75in",
      latex_column_spec = "C{0.75in}"
    ) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      6, width = "0.75in",
      latex_column_spec = "C{0.75in}"
    )

  cat("\\begingroup\n")
  cat("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2pt}\n")
  cat(as.character(tbl), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\endgroup\n\n")
  } else {
    tbl <- kableExtra::kbl(
      lesson_df, format = "html", align = c("c", "c", "l", "l", "c", "c")
    ) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "condensed"),
        full_width = FALSE
      ) |>
      kableExtra::row_spec(
        row = seq(2L, nrow(lesson_df), by = 2L),
        background = stripe_hex
      )
    cat(as.character(tbl), "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
